question: Regulation (EU) 2025/40 on packaging and packaging waste (PPWR) will apply, in principle, from 12 August 2026. Its aim is to reduce the adverse environmental impact of packaging, improve its recyclability and develop the secondary raw materials market. At the same time, European recycling companies are facing high energy costs, price pressures and difficulties in finding buyers for recycled materials.

It is particularly important to ensure that the new regulatory obligations lead to a genuine increase in demand for European recycled materials, rather than merely increasing the operating costs of businesses. In light of the above: 1.
Has the Commission assessed the impact of the PPWR on small and medium-sized recycling enterprises, including their compliance costs and competitiveness vis-à-vis non-EU producers?
What mechanisms are in place to ensure that the mandatory recycled content in packaging translates into stable demand for secondary raw materials produced by European companies?
Does the Commission plan to monitor the effects of the PPWR on the prices of recycled materials, the profitability of companies and any potential market concentration around the largest operators?
